# VachaVox

> Local-first voice dictation for macOS. Hold a key, speak, and your words appear where your cursor is.

## Facts
- Download: https://github.com/anujraja404/vachavox/releases/download/v0.6.3/VachaVox-v0.6.3-B23.zip
- Platform: macOS 14.0 or later
- Stack: Swift 5.10, Core ML, FluidAudio, WhisperKit, KeyboardShortcuts
- Models: local Core ML voice model required; Parakeet and Whisper-family models supported
- Privacy: no audio or transcript data is uploaded by the app; analytics are not included
- License: MIT License with a Commons Clause

## Build
- swift build
- swift test
- Scripts/package_app.sh
